title: U.S. Drought Monitor (USDM) — Weekly Drought Classification
description: Weekly drought-classification polygon product jointly produced by NDMC (University of Nebraska-Lincoln), USDA, and NOAA. Released every Thursday morning; data valid through Tuesday 08:00 EDT of the preceding week. Inactive governance candidate only — no connector activation, schedule, release, or publication is authorized by this descriptor.
authority_notes: Jointly authoritative product for broad-scale drought-extent classification. Not a forecast, not a parcel observation, not an emergency declaration.

publisher.name: National Drought Mitigation Center (NDMC), University of Nebraska-Lincoln

owner_or_steward.name: NDMC / USDA / NOAA (joint producers); NDMC hosts canonical distribution

cadence.freshness_expectation: New release every Thursday at approximately 08:30 ET; data valid through Tuesday 08:00 EDT of the preceding week.

admissibility_limits.limitations: USDM is a broad-scale expert-synthesis classification. Do not infer parcel, field, farm, person, facility, water-right, crop-loss, or emergency-status conditions from USDM classifications alone. Native D0-D4 classifications and short-/long-term impact markers must be preserved without silent recoding into KFM domain truth.
